commit_limitation: Protocol and implementation are timestamped and hash-pinned before native launch; uncommitted worktree, not a Git preregistration commit.
purpose: Repair benchmark/scorer validity and test persistent multi-query correction/retention with one bounded D1 MiniCPM5 fast-memory fine-tuning pilot before RSI.
hypothesis: Query-selective counterfactual multi-fact training plus train-only base-teacher preservation may improve an existing shared SGDN-2 writer/reader while preserving unrelated exact answers.
parent_role: Preserved M3 shared ownership candidate; its retained/general memory quality is NOT accepted. M3 repair and M4 rejected candidates are not used.

dataset.scope: Fresh small synthetic diagnostic, now exposed; only one counterfactual family in each evaluation split. No broad or sealed audit claim.

chronology: Each evaluation episode appends two source pages once, answers five questions on that shared state, saves/reloads without source reencoding, appends one correction to that same state, and answers changed/unaffected/unknown/general questions. Training uses functional state reconstruction and unrolled gradients per example, not deployment persistence.
correction_scope: Latest-value append diagnostic; not deletion, revocation or neural unlearning. Historical fact information may remain encoded.
controls: Shuffled is the same-family counterfactual state. Last-chunk uses only the final page or correction. Disabled is exact frozen-base inference; full-context supplies observed facts and correction to the baseline prompt. Fixed fast path; no case-role router.

training.optimizer_semantics: Int8 Muon momentum with FP32 parameters/gradients; auxiliary FP32 AdamW for nonmatrix parameters. No claim of BF16 resident or FP8 training.
training.schedule: Seeded shuffle of round-robin query positions across all eight training worlds, one visit to each of 96 cases. Evaluation labels never train or select settings.
training.objective: Response-only teacher-forced CE for all training cases; additionally KL(base-disabled teacher || fast-enabled student) over answer positions on 16 train-only general examples, weight 1.0. The base teacher is frozen and sees the same prefix/target history.

acceptance.failed_gate: Reject candidate and preserve parent; do not promote or advance neural RSI.

restart_policy: One independent guarded restart is a mechanical diagnostic even if quality rejects. It loads the exact candidate and first heldout corrected image, without training or source reencoding, and reproduces all seven corrected-stage answers.
publication: None. Candidate saved under isolated run path. Source and selected defaults are unchanged. Passing only qualifies this small diagnostic, not deployment or RSI.
